edgeExploration.findings: Duplicate identities decode correctly. Symlinks/dangling MEMFS reads and hardlinks fail direct member extraction; safe target resolution is required before TAR entry exposure. Missing end markers are rejected by existing engine but accepted by Python; truncated payload/checksum errors remain explicit. Subsequent valid member recovers.

next: Add correctly labeled TAR routing only after duplicate identity, hard/symlink, malicious paths, malformed headers, limits and actual content interactions are validated. Compressed tar layers remain separate.
